description: Comprehensive healthy recipe database integrated with FoodLab. Diagnosis-aware, executive function friendly, sensory-considerate recipes.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Let chicken rest 5 min, then slice
Toss spinach, avocado, tomatoes in bowl
Drizzle olive oil and squeeze lemon
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High protein (35g), healthy fats from avocado, supports dopamine production and brain function

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: High protein stabilizes blood sugar and supports dopamine. Omega-3 from avocado.
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: Omega-3 and protein support mood regulation

sensory_notes.texture: Mixed (soft avocado, crunchy spinach, tender chicken)

recipes.name: Chia Pudding Overnight
instructions: Mix chia seeds, almond milk, honey in jar
recipes.executive_function_rating: Very low (prep night before when you have energy)
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Rich in omega-3, fiber, supports digestion and mental focus. Sustained energy release.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Prep when you have energy, eat when you don't. Omega-3 for brain.
why_diagnosis_friendly.autism: Predictable texture (smooth), same every time - safe food potential
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: Zero morning effort - made night before

sensory_notes.texture: Smooth, slightly gelatinous (can be adjusted with more/less liquid)

allergen_info: Contains tree nuts (almond milk) - substitute with oat milk

substitutions.almond_milk: Oat milk, coconut milk, regular milk

recipes.name: Veggie Stir-Fry
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High in vitamins, antioxidants, supports immune function. Fiber for gut health.

why_diagnosis_friendly.autism: Can be made with preferred vegetables only - customizable texture

sensory_notes.smell: Strong (garlic, ginger, soy sauce) - open windows

substitutions.vegetables: Use ANY vegetables you like or have

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Blend banana, oats, eggs, cinnamon until smooth
Flip and cook 2 min other side
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Fiber from oats, natural sugars, protein from eggs. Sustained energy.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Natural sugars + protein + fiber = stable energy. Good pre-medication breakfast.
why_diagnosis_friendly.autism: Predictable taste, soft texture, naturally sweet (safe food potential)

allergen_info: Contains eggs, gluten-free if using certified GF oats

substitutions.eggs: Flax eggs (1 tbsp flax + 3 tbsp water per egg)

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Lemon Dill
instructions: Season with garlic, dill, salt, pepper
recipes.nutrition_benefits: VERY HIGH in omega-3 fatty acids (2g). Supports heart, brain, reduces inflammation. Essential for depression/ADHD.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Omega-3 supports brain function and focus. High protein.
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: Omega-3 has strong evidence for mood support

substitutions.salmon: Other fatty fish (mackerel, trout) or chicken if fish aversion

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Toast (Zero Energy)
instructions: Add sliced banana if you have energy
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Protein, healthy fats, quick energy. Gets SOMETHING in you.

why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: When you can't cook AT ALL - this is better than nothing
why_diagnosis_friendly.all: Survival meal when executive function = zero

sensory_notes.texture: Smooth peanut butter, soft bread (or crunchy if toasted)
sensory_notes.taste: Nutty, slightly sweet if banana added

substitutions.peanut_butter: Almond butter, sunflower seed butter, nutella

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High protein (20g), probiotics for gut health, antioxidants from berries.

why_diagnosis_friendly.anxiety: Probiotics support gut-brain axis (90% of serotonin in gut)
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: Protein + quick assembly when energy low
why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Protein for focus, quick to make

sensory_notes.texture: Creamy yogurt, crunchy granola, soft berries

allergen_info: Dairy, may contain gluten in granola

recipes.name: Instant Ramen UPGRADED
instructions: Drain some broth if too salty
Add soy sauce, sriracha if wanted
recipes.nutrition_benefits: UPGRADED junk food. Egg adds protein, spinach adds vitamins/iron. Better than plain ramen.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Quick dopamine hit from comfort food + actual nutrition added
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: When you can only manage instant food - this makes it slightly better

sensory_notes.texture: Soft noodles, runny egg yolk if done right

recipes.name: Batch Chili Con Carne
instructions: Brown ground beef in large pot
Add chopped onion and garlic, cook 5 min
recipes.executive_function_rating: Initial effort HIGH, then set-and-forget for week
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High protein, fiber from beans, iron. Freezes perfectly. One cook = 8 meals.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Cook once when hyperfocused, eat all week with zero effort
why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: Make on good day, have food for entire bad week

sensory_notes.texture: Ground beef, soft beans, thick sauce

recipes.storage: Fridge 4 days, freezer 3 months in portions

recipes.name: Overnight Oats (Customizable)
instructions: Mix oats, milk, yogurt, honey in jar
Add toppings (berries, nuts, chocolate chips, whatever)
recipes.executive_function_rating: Very low (prep when you can, eat when you can't)
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Fiber, sustained energy, customizable nutrition based on toppings.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Prep when you have executive function, eat when you don't
why_diagnosis_friendly.autism: Same base every time, add your safe toppings

allergen_info: Gluten if not certified GF oats, dairy

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Spinach
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High protein (21g), iron from spinach, choline for brain. Perfect ADHD breakfast.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Protein + choline = dopamine + focus. Fast to make before meds.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Egg
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Healthy fats, protein, fiber. Supports brain and mood.

why_diagnosis_friendly.adhd: Omega-3 from avocado, protein from egg

sensory_notes.texture: Creamy avocado, runny or firm egg (your choice)

recipes.name: Simple Lentil Soup (Batch)
instructions: Add garlic, cumin, paprika, cook 1 min
recipes.nutrition_benefits: High fiber, plant protein, iron, folate. Supports gut health and mood.

why_diagnosis_friendly.anxiety: Fiber + gut health supports anxiety reduction
why_diagnosis_friendly.autism: Smooth texture (can blend if preferred), predictable

sensory_notes.texture: Soft, thick soup (can blend for smoother)

recipes.name: Banan with Almond Butter (Zero Energy)
instructions: Spread almond butter on banana OR dip bites in it
recipes.nutrition_benefits: Quick energy from banana, protein and healthy fats from almond butter.

why_diagnosis_friendly.depression: When you literally can do nothing else - this is SOMETHING
why_diagnosis_friendly.all: Emergency food for lowest executive function days

substitutions.almond_butter: Peanut butter, sunflower seed butter, skip entirely

recipes.name: Cheese and Crackers (Zero Energy)
instructions: Add apple if you have energy

why_diagnosis_friendly.all: No cooking, minimal assembly, gets food in you

adhd_focus.description: High protein, stable blood sugar, brain-supporting meals

day_1.breakfast: recipe_011 - Scrambled Eggs with Spinach (protein + choline)

day_2.breakfast: recipe_010 - Overnight Oats with protein powder
day_2.dinner: recipe_001 - Grilled Chicken with sweet potato

adhd_focus.note: Focus on protein at every meal, omega-3, avoid sugar spikes

depression_survival.description: Minimal effort meals for low-energy days
depression_survival.strategy: Batch cook on good day, rely on zero-energy meals on bad days
depression_survival.good_day: Make recipe_009 (Chili) and recipe_013 (Lentil Soup) - freeze in portions
bad_days: Breakfast: recipe_002 (made night before) or recipe_006 (peanut butter toast)
Lunch: recipe_009 from freezer, microwave 3 min
depression_survival.note: ZERO shame for zero-energy meals. Eating SOMETHING > eating perfectly.

safe_base_meals: recipe_004 - Banana Oat Pancakes (soft, naturally sweet)
recipe_006 - Peanut Butter Toast (simple, same every time)
recipe_010 - Overnight Oats (customize with safe toppings)
recipe_009 - Chili (can customize spice level to zero)
autism_sensory_safe.strategy: Identify 5-7 safe foods, rotate them. Expand SLOWLY with minimal pressure.
autism_sensory_safe.note: Repetition is OK. Same meal every day is OK if that's what works.

anxiety_gut_health.note: Avoid: Excess caffeine, alcohol, processed food

nutrition_tips.title: Protein at Every Meal
nutrition_tips.tip: Especially important for ADHD - protein supports dopamine production and stable blood sugar. Aim for 20-30g per meal.

nutrition_tips.title: Omega-3 is Essential
nutrition_tips.tip: Strong evidence for brain health, depression, ADHD. Eat fatty fish 2-3x week or supplement. Salmon, mackerel, sardines, walnuts.

nutrition_tips.title: Gut Health = Mental Health
nutrition_tips.tip: 90% of serotonin made in gut. Support with probiotics (yogurt), prebiotics (bananas, oats), and fiber (vegetables, lentils).

nutrition_tips.title: Hydration Matters
nutrition_tips.tip: Dehydration worsens ADHD symptoms, anxiety, and depression. Aim for 2L water/day. Add lemon or cucumber if plain water boring.

nutrition_tips.title: Blood Sugar Stability
nutrition_tips.tip: Spikes and crashes worsen all symptoms. Eat regular meals, combine carbs with protein/fat, avoid pure sugar.

nutrition_tips.title: Batch Cooking Saves Lives
nutrition_tips.tip: Cook once on good day = food for entire week. Perfect for executive dysfunction. Freezer is your friend.

nutrition_tips.title: Zero-Energy Meals Are Valid
nutrition_tips.tip: Peanut butter toast > nothing. Cheese and crackers > nothing. Survival mode is OK. No shame.

nutrition_tips.title: Safe Foods Are Valid
nutrition_tips.tip: Autism: If you can only eat 5 foods, that's OK. Work with what works. Expand slowly with zero pressure.

nutrition_tips.title: Medication Timing Matters
nutrition_tips.tip: ADHD: Eat BEFORE medication (kills appetite). High-protein breakfast recommended. Avoid taking on empty stomach.

nutrition_tips.title: Anti-Inflammatory Diet Helps
nutrition_tips.tip: Depression and anxiety have inflammation component. Focus on: fatty fish, nuts, olive oil, berries, greens.

nutrition_tips.title: Avoid These if Struggling
nutrition_tips.tip: Excess caffeine (anxiety), alcohol (depression next day), processed food (inflammation), pure sugar (crashes).

nutrition_tips.title: Meal Prep Is Executive Function Support
nutrition_tips.tip: Pre-cut vegetables, rotisserie chicken, frozen meals = valid strategies. Not lazy - smart.

for_sarah: Never shame food choices - survival > perfection
Zero-energy meals are VALID - peanut butter toast > nothing
Safe foods for autism = respect them, don't push variety
Medication timing matters for ADHD (eat before meds)
Budget awareness - not everyone can afford 'perfect' nutrition
Some people genuinely can't cook - meet them where they are
